name: The Weight of Ambition.
source:
Lira’s ambition has brought her far – but now, to rise higher, she may have to betray her wife, Lute. Is success worth the cost of love?

[From [url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/the-weight-of-ambition]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莉拉的野心让她走得更远，但现在，为了走得更高，她可能不得不背叛她的妻子鲁特。成功值得付出爱情的代价吗？

[来自[url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/the-weight-of-ambition]Itch.io[/url]]
